init.title: Polling strategy
init.description:
While active, devices are polled at the active interval. After 1 minute without changes the interval grows step by step up to the idle maximum. Controlling a device in HA, receiving a gateway push, or a change detected by polling (e.g. a wall panel) switches back to fast polling immediately.

During quiet hours (e.g. night) the quiet interval is used while idle; 0 stops polling entirely and relies on push and controls to wake it up.

data.quiet_interval: Quiet hours poll interval (s, 0 = stop polling)
